descriptions.w3d_d28e_close_node_801d3be0: Finish a node: runs the match at 0x801d3930, pushes the node on the stack at +72, then in sequence mode advances the name index (a completed sequence records the node and returns 0x90000005) and dispatches the node through 0x801a37a0, restoring the index; outside sequence mode it only dispatches. Pops the stack and returns 0 unless an error is returned.
